rates.description: Standard rate — applies to all services and goods not listed below
Restaurant and catering — food component only (staffing at 21%)
Renovation of private residential buildings older than 10 years — labour only, not materials
conditions: Building must be used exclusively or primarily as private dwelling
Building must be at least 10 years old
Applies to labour — materials are still 21%
Client must provide written declaration confirming conditions are met

rates.description: Construction and renovation of social housing recognised by authorities
Intra-EU B2B supply — buyer must be VAT-registered in another EU country
conditions: Buyer must have valid EU VAT number
Buyer must be in a different EU member state

decision_guide: 1. Is the buyer in another EU country and VAT-registered? → 0% (reverse charge). 2. Is the job renovation of a private home older than 10 years? → 6% on labour, 21% on materials. 3. Is the service food catering? → 12% on food, 21% on staffing. 4. Everything else → 21%.
